digest.component_or_area: CLI author guides and commit-trailer documentation
propositions: CLI-served author guides contain internal cross-references as consumer-relative paths that dangle for repo-less clients without a rebar checkout
The required commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT) has no CLI-discoverable entry point beyond rebar verify-commit-ticket help, leaving consumers unaware of the format discovery path
Packaged guides must repoint all dangling references to use either rebar explain topics for sibling guides or canonical https://github.com/navapbc/rebar hosted URLs for repo-only docs
A link-resolution guard test must enforce that no packaged guide contains consumer-relative markdown link targets or bare repo paths, allowing only https://, http://, intra-doc anchors, and mailto:
rebar explain commit-trailer must serve a new packaged guide that quotes EXPECTED_FORMAT verbatim and explains self-check procedures, registered in AUTHOR_GUIDES alongside plan and review
The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring and test coverage must be updated to reflect the new commit-trailer guide so the guide list stays synchronized with the registry
